data_description.stock_loss_pot: Realised stock losses this year (only offset against stock gains).
data_description.general_loss_pot: Other realised losses this year (offset against all gains).

user.title: Add stock
user.description: Enter a ticker (e.g. AAPL, SAP.DE), ISIN, WKN or name. Yahoo Finance and onvista are searched.

data_description.query: ISIN/WKN also finds ETFs Yahoo does not know (via onvista).

select.title: Choose listing
select.description: Pick the instrument and trading venue to use for prices.

details.title: Add stock
details.description:
{instrument}

Leave quantity at 0 and no savings plan to only track the price. Amounts in {currency}.

data_description.name: Leave empty to use the name from Yahoo Finance.
data_description.quantity: Number of shares held (0 = watch only).
data_description.purchase_price: Average purchase price in portfolio currency, without fees.
data_description.purchase_fees: Sum of all fees paid when buying.
data_description.asset_type: Determines partial exemption and loss offsetting.

savings_plan.name: Savings plan
savings_plan.description: Optional. Executions are calculated automatically from historical closing prices (non-trading day: next trading day) and added to the position. Plan fees are separate from the sell fees.

data_description.plan_day: Day of month (later days are moved to the month's end). Ignored for weekly plans.
data_description.plan_start: First possible execution. For weekly plans this is the first execution.
data_description.plan_fee_included: On: the fee is deducted from the amount. Off: the fee is charged on top.
data_description.plan_active: Switch off to pause the plan.

income.name: Income
income.description: Distributing: distributions are calculated automatically from Yahoo data from now on (quantity on the ex-date, tax estimated) and added to the total result. onvista instruments: enter manually.

data_description.distribution: Accumulating: no distributions. Distributing: dividends/distributions are counted.
data_description.dividends_received: Total of past distributions after tax, e.g. from your broker statements.
data_description.advance_lump_sum_taxed: Sum of all Vorabpauschalen taxed so far (amount before partial exemption, see annual tax statement). Reduces the taxable gain on sale.

reconfigure.title: Edit {symbol}
reconfigure.description: Amounts in {currency}. {executions} calculated savings plan executions and {payments} distributions have been added below; compare with your broker and correct if necessary. After additional one-off purchases enter the total quantity, the average purchase price and the sum of all purchase fees.
